# Silverline Engineering Limited — Comprehensive Corporate & Engineering Reference

## 1. Company Profile
- **Entity Name**: Silverline Engineering Limited
- **Founded**: Established in Zambia
- **Industry**: Construction, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Solar & Renewable Energy
- **Headquarters**: Plot 397a/40/d Off Kafue Road, Makeni, Lusaka, Zambia
- **Fabrication Plant & Regional Base**: Stand No. 1204, Light Industrial Area, Kitwe, Zambia
- **Official Website**: https://silverline-engineering.com
- **Corporate Email**: info@silverlineng.com
- **Phone Lines**: +260 966 626579 / +260 771 814040 / +260 977 467664
- **Working Hours**: Monday to Friday: 08:00 – 17:00 (Central Africa Time)

Silverline Engineering Limited is a premier Zambian multidisciplinary engineering and general contracting firm. The company undertakes complex, large-scale commercial, industrial, institutional, and civil infrastructure projects across Zambia and the Southern African development region.

---

## 2. Statutory Certifications & Regulatory Accreditations
- **NCC (National Council for Construction)**: Certified for General Building, Civil Engineering, Electrical, and Specialist Works in Zambia.
- **EIZ (Engineering Institution of Zambia)**: Corporate membership with certified professional engineers and project directors.
- **ERB (Energy Regulation Board)**: Licensed for Renewable Energy (Solar PV) and Petroleum Infrastructure construction.
- **ZPPA (Zambia Public Procurement Authority)**: Registered supplier and contractor for government, municipal, and international donor projects.

---

## 3. Core Disciplines & Technical Capabilities

### Civil & Structural Engineering
- Commercial developments: shopping centers, office complexes, bank branches, and retail parks.
- Industrial developments: manufacturing plants, processing facilities, warehouses, and storage sheds.
- Concrete works: suspended slabs, heavy foundations, columns, retaining walls, and water reservoirs.
- Structural steel: design, fabrication, and erection of steel trusses, frames, and portal systems.
- Earthworks: bulk excavation, site leveling, grading, compaction, and stabilization.
- Drainage & infrastructure: concrete culverts, stormwater management systems, paving, and access roads.

### Electrical Engineering
- Power distribution: high-voltage (HV), medium-voltage (MV), and low-voltage (LV) reticulation.
- Transformer substations: installation, cabling, switchgear, and commissioning.
- Industrial electrical installations: Motor Control Centers (MCC), power cabling, variable frequency drives (VFD).
- Building services: commercial wiring, structured cabling, backup diesel generator synchronization.
- Safety & security: lightning protection, earthing systems, fire alarm reticulation, and perimeter surveillance wiring.

### Mechanical Engineering
- Piping systems: industrial process piping, high-pressure lines, compressed air, and steam lines.
- HVAC systems: commercial air conditioning, central ventilation, dust extraction, and chiller plants.
- Pumping installations: industrial pump stations, water treatment, booster pumps, and fluid transfer.
- Heavy steel fabrication: custom structural elements, hoppers, silos, chutes, platforms, and gantries.
- Plant maintenance: routine shutdowns, conveyor belt maintenance, and structural retrofitting.

### Solar & Renewable Energy
- Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Solar: rooftop solar PV installations for factories, malls, and agricultural facilities.
- Ground-mounted Solar PV: mini-grid and off-grid solar power stations.
- Hybrid Energy Solutions: solar PV integrated with battery storage (BESS) and diesel generator automation.
- Solar Water Pumping: high-capacity agricultural and rural community water pumping systems.

### In-House Facilities & Fleet
- **5,000 m² Fabrication Plant**: Located in Kitwe’s Light Industrial Area, equipped for prefabrication of heavy structural steel.
- **CNC Plasma Cutting**: High-precision metal profiling and automated steel cutting.
- **Equipment Fleet**: Mobile cranes, excavators, tipper trucks, concrete mixers, roller compactors, and survey equipment.
- **Quality & Safety Assurance**: Zero-Harm safety policy, daily toolbox talks, and ISO-aligned quality inspection protocols.

## 4. Landmark Projects Case Studies

### 1. East Park Mall Expansion
- **Client**: Napoli Property
- **Location**: Lusaka, Zambia
- **Category**: Commercial
- **Status**: Completed
- **Timeline**: 2023 - Present
- **Overview**: Prestigious commercial expansion works at Zambia's premier retail destination. Executed structural additions, reinforced concrete works, and modern architectural extensions while the shopping center remained fully operational and accessible to thousands of daily visitors.
- **Scope**: Structural steel framing, reinforced concrete suspended slabs, commercial facades, service integration, drainage reticulation, active site safety management.
- **Client Quote (Gillian Casilli, Napoli Property)**: "The team delivered the East Park Mall expansion works with professionalism, strong communication, and careful site management. Managing works responsibly alongside a busy mall kept us well informed throughout."

### 2. MECO Milling Plant
- **Client**: MECO Milling Ltd
- **Location**: Lusaka, Zambia
- **Category**: Industrial
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Turnkey construction of a high-capacity commercial grain milling and agro-processing plant. Included deep foundations for grain silos, mill machinery bays, administrative blocks, and heavy truck loading yards.
- **Scope**: Bulk earthworks, heavy reinforced concrete foundations, prefabricated steel warehouse construction, electrical distribution network, drainage infrastructure.

### 3. UNDP Bulking Centers
- **Client**: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Zambia
- **Location**: Multiple Rural Districts, Zambia
- **Category**: Institutional & Agricultural
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Construction of agricultural aggregation warehouses, produce bulking centers, and community renewable energy facilities for the United Nations Development Programme to boost food security and post-harvest management.
- **Scope**: Warehouse construction, solar-powered lighting, boreholes, water storage tanks, and access roads.

### 4. Ndeke Mosque
- **Client**: Community Development Trust
- **Location**: Kitwe, Copperbelt, Zambia
- **Category**: Religious & Architectural
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Iconic religious community facility featuring reinforced concrete domes, minarets, prayer halls, ablution facilities, and intricate acoustic finishes.

### 5. Oryx Munali Filling Station
- **Client**: Oryx Energies Zambia
- **Location**: Lusaka, Zambia
- **Category**: Commercial Petroleum
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Comprehensive service station build including canopy fabrication and erection, underground fuel storage tank installation, hazardous-zone electrical cabling, forecourt paving, and convenience retail store.

### 6. Alix Investment Factory
- **Client**: Alix Investment Limited
- **Location**: Lusaka, Zambia
- **Category**: Industrial Manufacturing
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Construction of an industrial manufacturing facility comprising pre-engineered steel warehouse framing, heavy equipment slab flooring, overhead crane rails, and administrative offices.

### 7. Eco Petroleum Chalala
- **Client**: Eco Petroleum Zambia
- **Location**: Chalala, Lusaka, Zambia
- **Category**: Commercial Petroleum
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Turnkey service station construction including underground petroleum storage tanks, forecourt canopy, retail building, car wash facility, and interlock paving.

### 8. Limulunga Day Secondary School
- **Client**: Ministry of Education / Infrastructure Development
- **Location**: Limulunga, Western Province, Zambia
- **Category**: Institutional
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Construction of educational campus facilities including multi-classroom blocks, science laboratories, ablution facilities, and solar-assisted water supply systems.

### 9. Afro Oil Filling Station
- **Client**: Afro Oil Zambia
- **Location**: Lusaka, Zambia
- **Category**: Commercial Petroleum
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Civil engineering works, pump island construction, concrete forecourts, canopy structural steelwork, and electrical control panels.

### 10. Victoria Falls Road Rehabilitation
- **Client**: Road Development Agency (RDA)
- **Location**: Southern Province, Zambia
- **Category**: Civil Infrastructure
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Civil infrastructure development, earthmoving, sub-base preparation, culvert installation, and drainage reticulation.

### 11. ENGIC Solar Plants
- **Client**: ENGIC Energy
- **Location**: Central & Lusaka Provinces, Zambia
- **Category**: Solar & Renewable Energy
- **Status**: Completed
- **Overview**: Commercial solar photovoltaic power plants, mounting structures, inverter stations, grid interconnection, and remote performance monitoring systems.
